items.title: XRP Ledger defends emergency patch for unlimited XRP bug
items.summary: The XRP Ledger Foundation pushed back against claims that its emergency security patch was forced on network operators.

items.title: Ledger attack spreads to EU, AI finds 18 trillion XRP bug: Hodlers Digest
items.summary: An user reports buying a tampered Ledger from a big retailer in Europe. Security researchers use AI to uncover a $94 billion XRP bug but receive just a $250K bounty.
